expect_at(scroll, 20, 82, "a scroll sits at its own x/y");
expect_size(scroll, 920, 404, "a scroll keeps its viewport size");

expect_hit(50, 380, "S2", "below a fitted stack is its scroll container");
expect_nav("left", NAV_RIGHT, "right", "right moves along a row stack");
expect_nav("right", NAV_LEFT, "left", "left moves back along a row stack");
expect(strcmp(scroll_at(550, 40), "list") == 0, "scroll at finds a scroll inside a stack");
expect(strcmp(scroll_at(550, 10), "") == 0, "a stack is not a scroll container");
expect(has_focusable(elems, count, "right", 130, 305), "stack children move with the scroll offset");

index 2f125e0..89573aa 100644
--- a/CMakeLists.txt
+++ b/CMakeLists.txt
@@ -272,22 +275,20 @@ if(NOT DEFINED ENV{VITASDK})
     target_link_libraries(hit_test_harness m pthread)
     add_test(NAME hit_test_harness COMMAND hit_test_harness)
 
-    add_executable(scroll_math_harness
-      tests/scroll_math_harness.c
-      src/ui/instance_tree.c
-      src/ui/scroll.c
-      src/core/arena.c
-      ${PLATFORM_SOURCES}
-    )

+    add_executable(scroll_math_harness tests/scroll_math_harness.c src/ui/scroll.c)
+    target_link_libraries(scroll_math_harness m)
     add_test(NAME scroll_math_harness COMMAND scroll_math_harness)
 
+    add_executable(layout_harness tests/layout_harness.c src/ui/layout.c)
+    add_test(NAME layout_harness COMMAND layout_harness)
+
     # Links raylib only because input.c and text_input_host.c also hold the raylib polls; the harness drives the
     # input_apply_* and vd_text_input_apply_keys steps.
     add_executable(input_harness
       tests/input_harness.c
       src/ui/input.c
       src/ui/instance_tree.c
+      src/ui/layout.c
       src/ui/focus_nav.c
       src/ui/scroll.c
       src/core/arena.c
